design.service: nitrifying biofilter — Nitrosomonas + Nitrobacter biofilm on moving-bed media
design.organisms: Nitrosomonas europaea (NH3 -> NO2-); Nitrobacter winogradskyi (NO2- -> NO3-)
design.stoichiometry: NH4+ + 1.5 O2 -> NO2- + 2H+ + H2O (Nitrosomonas); NO2- + 0.5 O2 -> NO3- (Nitrobacter); combined: NH4+ + 2 O2 -> NO3- + 2H+ + H2O
design.O2_demand: 2 mol O2 per mol NH4+ nitrified (4.57 mg O2 per mg NH4+-N); aerobic — the bacteria die without dissolved O2
design.pH: 7.0-8.5 optimal; below 6.5 the nitrification rate collapses
design.temperature: 25-30 C optimal; below 15 C nitrification slows dramatically
design.media: moving-bed biofilm carriers (K1 micro class); surface area sets the bacterial population
design.failure_mode: ammonia accumulates to lethal levels within 24-48 h if the bacteria die (O2 starvation, pH crash, chemical shock)
design.basis: A-M-415; TECHTREE agriculture.aquaponics (nitrogen cycle); TECHTREE space-resources MELiSSA C2 nitrifying compartment

nozzles.service: biofilter bleed to the nutrient tank
ammonia-rich fish waste water (NH3/NH4+ from the gills)
nitrified water to the optional sanitizer (NO3- passes; sloughed cells die in food-safety mode)

material: HDPE or PVC for the water. The frame is not the wetted part. Corrosion allowance does not apply to the polymer.
